mapper.sql:
select aa.shop_no, aa.bill_no, aa.bill_date, aa.bill_type, a.entry_id, a.entry_name, a.entry_unit, a.entry_price, ifnull(round(a.total_amount/a.total_qty, 2) , 0) as cost_price, a.total_qty, a.create_time, a.update_time from po_order_entry a left join po_order aa on a.bill_no=aa.bill_no
union all select bb.shop_no, bb.bill_no, bb.bill_date, bb.bill_type, b.entry_id, b.entry_name, b.entry_unit, b.entry_price, b.cost_price, b.total_qty, b.create_time, b.update_time from se_order_entry b left join se_order bb on b.bill_no=bb.bill_no
union all select cc.shop_no, cc.bill_no, cc.bill_date, cc.bill_type, c.entry_id, c.entry_name, c.entry_unit, c.entry_price, c.cost_price, c.total_qty, c.create_time, c.update_time from wh_order_entry c left join wh_order cc on c.bill_no=cc.bill_no
mapper.select: select count(*) as totalCount, sum(if(bill_type in ('CG_ORDER', 'WH_RK_ORDER'), total_qty, 0)) as incomeQty, sum(if(bill_type in ('CG_ORDER', 'WH_RK_ORDER'), 0, total_qty)) as outcomeQty, sum(if(bill_type in ('CG_ORDER', 'WH_RK_ORDER'), total_qty, -total_qty)) as balanceQty from () kk
